title: panel synthesis output — report.json
description: Output contract of a panel's synthesis hand, every mode (wl-mv5m7qvgkxhpj4 CONTRACT.md § 1). The classifier publishes it as out/report.json and its markdown as out/REPORT.md; references/panel/scripts/panel.ts check enforces the rules the descriptions state.

legs.description: One entry per lab, all three labs, copied from out/status.json: status and model exactly as status.json has them.

model.description: status.json's model for the lab; the empty string when status.json has null.

reason.description: status.json's reason for a missing or excluded leg; the empty string when there is none.

lab.description: The lab of the model writing this synthesis.

builderLab.description: true when the dispatch named this lab a builder lab of the workload.

findings.description: One entry per synthesized finding, in report order.

section.description: The text of the ## heading of REPORT.md the finding sits under.

supportIds.description: Leg item ids (<lab>-<n>) that assert this finding. Its n/3 is the number of distinct labs here.

refuteIds.description: Leg item ids that contradict it. Non-empty together with supportIds puts the finding in the mode's disagreement section.

dropped.description: Every landed leg item id not in any finding, each with the reason it was cut.

reason.description: Why it was cut: taste, duplicate of an id already counted, out of lane, unreceipted. Never empty.
